name: level3-playthrough-ecology
description: Level 3 (Treranium Depths) ecological shutdown scenario: massive krackle and obliviax blasts with no mitigation, long tick cycles to trigger ecology collapse. `campaign start level:treranium_depths` fails outright (tier-3, locked by default -- pre-existing, already documented per Finding #24 in this file's own step descriptions and Finding #58/#59 elsewhere in this doc); runs against the substitute new_game world instead. The named ecological-shutdown outcome is otherwise completely real: levelEndReason:'ecological_shutdown' fires at tick 184, taking all 7 employees with it. See Finding #61 for the depth-mismatch fix applied here.

campaign start level:treranium_depths FAILS at step 1 ("Level treranium_depths is locked. Complete previous levels first." -- Campaign.ts unlocks only tier-1 levels by default, treranium_depths is tier 3) -- a real, pre-existing scenario bug, not introduced by this conversion. Every subsequent command runs against whatever bare new_game seed:3666 produced instead of the intended level, and by this cycle the mismatch leaves the Fire step's execute button disabled -- validateBlastPlan genuinely rejects this plan on the wrong world, not a selector or tab-visibility issue. The detonate itself stays a command rather than force a click that cannot land, but the resulting BlastReportModal opens regardless of how the blast fired (Finding #12 -- state-reactive, not click-reactive) and blocks every later panel click until closed, so the close IS a real click here. See Finding #24 in the plan doc.

expect.note: Finding #61: all 6 `drill_plan grid` steps already declared `spacing:3` (the Drill panel's real default), so no rows/cols mismatch existed here -- but all 6 also declared a `depth` (12/12/14/14/16/16) other than the panel's real default of 6, the exact Ground rule #15/Finding #42 class, with none of their interaction arrays clicking a depth stepper. Fixed all 6 to `depth:6` (plus the usual `diameter:0.089`), matching the panel's true defaults, and re-traced fresh -- consistent with Finding #42's own precedent, the corrected shallower holes make blasts genuinely MORE violent, not less, which only helps this file's own 'ecological collapse' premise. The premise holds for real either way: `levelEndReason:'ecological_shutdown'` fires at tick 184, all 7 employees eventually dead (deathCount 7) from repeated blasts with zero mitigation. Two of the six drill cycles (the 4th and 6th) never actually detonate -- their `charge` commands request amounts (12kg, 15kg krackle) outside krackle's real valid range ([1-10kg]), a genuine, pre-existing authoring choice already flagged in this file's own step descriptions from the #479 pass, not something this pass fixed or needed to: the charge validation correctly rejects it, `sequence` still reports its nominal hole count since it doesn't check charge state, and the following `blast` then fails outright ('Invalid plan: Missing charge' on every hole) -- `stats` confirms 'Blasts performed: 4' out of 6 attempted cycles, and this file's `expect` blocks assert exactly that non-firing outcome at those two cycles (chargedCount:0, holeCount unchanged) rather than treating it as a bug. This file's own step descriptions already carry extensive, accurate documentation of the locked-level cascade (referencing Finding #24) predating this pass; not duplicated here beyond what's needed to record the depth fix. No contracts, vehicles, or hauling anywhere in this file -- pure blast-only, so none of the hauling-mechanism findings apply. Verified in both command mode and a real browser (interaction mode re-run twice for determinism, both clean), 107/107 steps.
